relations.rationale: Nell's age relative to Leo is unrelated to her age relative to Kira.
Age comparison between Nell and Leo has no bearing on height comparison between Ivo and Nell.
Nell being younger than Leo supports Leo being the oldest, since it's consistent with Leo being older than at least one participant.
Nell's age relative to Kira is unrelated to how well Kira's and Ivo's designs performed.
Nell being older than Kira has no bearing on the group gathering to compare notes and photograph creations.
Ivo being taller than Nell is unrelated to whether Ivo is taller than Noor.
Height comparison between Ivo and Nell is unrelated to age ranking of Leo.
Ivo being taller than Noor has no bearing on whether Noor's robot was easy to spot.
Leo being the oldest participant is unrelated to the number of parts used in Kira's or Ivo's designs.
Leo helping newer members in the afternoon supports the general narrative of everyone gathering and participating in the event, but doesn't directly imply the specific gathering activity.
Noor's robot being painted bright yellow supports it being easy to spot among others.
Kira's design using fewer parts than Ivo's is unrelated to whether both designs worked equally well.
The comparison of parts count between Kira's and Ivo's designs has no bearing on the group gathering to compare notes and photograph creations.
